betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The Linker is the tool that binds AR machines together. Shift-right-click one tile, right-click the second, and they're linked. The two tiles now share data and respond to each other's state changes.

The Linker isn't consumed on use, so you can reuse the same one for many bindings. You'll use it for the Guidance Computer, Rocket Assembling Machine, Wireless Transceiver pairing, Satellite Terminal, and Warp Controller.

This is the most-used tool in the AR progression. Keep at least 4 in your hotbar at all times.

§ePS:§f For complex networks, label your Linkers with anvils to remember which pairs are connected. The recipe is just Redstone, Gold Ingot, and Iron Ingot, no machine required.
